summary: Backend + frontend tested end-to-end. All requested features & bug fixes VERIFIED WORKING. Pytest: 7/7 passed (tutor signup survives restart, seeded tutors survive, admin survives, GET /api/bookings/{id} ACL — owner 200 / stranger 403 / unknown 404, POST /bookings creates pending booking, POST /bookings/{id}/confirm-mock flips to paid). Frontend Playwright confirmed: bookings tab → tap booking → /booking-detail/{id} → booking-status-card visible → for pending, booking-detail-pay-btn shown → tap → /payment/{id} → payment-pay-btn tap → returns to /booking-detail/{id} with status 'Payment complete'. NEW booking creation flow no longer auto-pays: /booking/[tutorId] → confirm → /booking-detail/{id} (NOT bookings list) with pending status + Continue-to-payment button. Fixed two collateral bugs while testing (see updated_files).

minor.issue: The tutor doc inserted in signup() (server.py L400-409) is missing the 'allows_remote' field. On next GET /tutors, TutorProfile pydantic validation crashed with 500: 'allows_remote Input should be a valid boolean, input_value=None'. I patched tutor_doc_to_model to coerce None → defaults so the list endpoint stays alive, but the RIGHT fix is to add default values ('allows_remote': False, 'currency': 'usd', etc.) directly into the signup() insert to match the seed shape. Same latent risk exists for tutors created before this fix — every self-signed-up tutor pollutes the list until the serializer is defensive.

ui_bugs.issue: `track(...)` was called on line 74 but `track` was never imported from '@/src/analytics'. Confirming a booking would throw ReferenceError at runtime, breaking the whole new flow (booking creation → booking-detail). I added the missing import. Please code-review; you may want to add ESLint no-undef gate to catch this class of bug.

action_items: Consider the cleaner backend fix: add sensible defaults (allows_remote=False, currency='usd', languages=[], etc.) at insertion time in the tutor branch of /api/auth/signup (server.py ~L400-409), matching the seed doc shape. My tutor_doc_to_model coercion is a defensive net but doesn't fix the underlying inconsistency.

Verify the toast-success component actually renders a `data-testid="toast-success"` element (I could not detect it after payment — either the testID is missing or the toast auto-dismisses in <1s and my post-tap check missed it). The functional outcome (status flips to paid, navigates back) is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: signup() creates tutor docs without the same defaults as seeded tutors — will keep biting whenever new fields are added to TutorProfile. Unify via a helper.
frontend booking/[tutorId].tsx was calling undefined `track()` — add tsc/eslint no-undef to CI.
server.py is ~1290 lines; consider splitting routes into modules (auth, tutors, bookings, messages, admin) per the >700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional flows passed; only the toast-success testID probe was inconclusive)

seed_data_creation: Test created ephemeral tutor accounts (tutor.new.<random>@example.com) and one parent 'other.<random>@test.dev' via signup. Also created new pending bookings under prv@test.dev while exercising the payment/creation flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed_data() bug fix verified: signing up a tutor with a non-@babybabel.dev email now survives `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Two seeded tutors + admin also intact after restart. GET /api/bookings/{id} enforces owner/tutor/admin ACL correctly (403 for strangers, 404 for unknown). New booking flow no longer auto-pays — payment_status starts as 'pending' and only flips to 'paid' after /confirm-mock. All Expo frontend flows for booking-tap → detail → payment → status-flip pass.
rca_of_issue: 1) Tutor signup 500-on-list: /api/auth/signup inserts tutor docs missing the 'allows_remote' field; TutorProfile is strictly-typed bool. Mitigated by coercing None→False (and other defaults) in tutor_doc_to_model. Ideal fix: put defaults in the signup insert. 2) Frontend booking confirm crash: missing `import { track } from '@/src/analytics'` in /app/frontend/app/booking/[tutorId].tsx — fixed.
